purpose: Provide a portable, evidence-based workflow for a bounded task without assuming a particular model, vendor, or tool runtime.
use_when: The requested task has an identifiable deliverable and can be broken into verifiable steps.
do_not_use_when: The request is outside the skill's domain or required authorization is missing.

inputs.name: task_request
inputs.description: The user's goal, constraints, and desired deliverable.
inputs.validation: Confirm required scope and output format before execution.

capabilities.name: file_access
capabilities.probe: Attempt a harmless read of the supplied workspace or use the host's declared capability list.
capabilities.fallback: If unavailable, do not claim file inspection; provide a plan or request an accessible artifact.

capabilities.name: terminal
capabilities.probe: Run a harmless version/help command only when command execution is explicitly available.
capabilities.fallback: If unavailable, provide commands for the user to run and mark execution NOT_RUN.

capabilities.name: test_runner
capabilities.probe: Check whether a supported test runner is installed before invoking it.
capabilities.fallback: Use a documented alternative only when semantically equivalent; otherwise report UNKNOWN.

workflow.action: Parse the request into scope, constraints, inputs, outputs, and acceptance criteria.
workflow.verification: Confirm each required input is present or explicitly mark it missing.
workflow.failure_action: Ask one targeted question when the missing detail makes a wrong guess costly; otherwise state a bounded assumption.

workflow.action: Detect actual runtime capabilities and permissions before selecting execution paths.
workflow.verification: Record each capability as available, unavailable, failed_probe, or not_tested.
workflow.failure_action: Choose an allowed fallback or switch to plan-only mode.

workflow.action: Execute the smallest reversible step that can produce useful evidence.
workflow.verification: Capture the exact action, exit status where available, and generated artifacts.
workflow.failure_action: Stop or recover safely; do not infer successful execution from an attempted command.

workflow.action: Run independent checks against the acceptance criteria.
workflow.verification: Tie every passed criterion to a test result, artifact, or explicit human review.
workflow.failure_action: Report failed and unverified criteria separately; fix and retest only within scope.

workflow.action: Deliver the result with limitations and reproducibility details.
workflow.verification: Ensure every claim is supported by captured evidence and every missing check is disclosed.
workflow.failure_action: Mark the overall outcome partial or unknown when evidence is incomplete.

success_criteria.criterion: All required deliverables exist and match the requested scope.
success_criteria.verification_method: Inspect artifact paths and validate content against the request.

success_criteria.criterion: No execution or verification claim is made without supporting evidence.
success_criteria.verification_method: Cross-check each claim against the evidence ledger.

success_criteria.criterion: Unavailable capabilities and unrun checks are explicitly disclosed.
success_criteria.verification_method: Review capability report and final status labels.

failure_modes.condition: Required tool is unavailable or permission denied.
failure_modes.response: Switch to a safe fallback or plan-only mode and record the capability as unavailable.

failure_modes.condition: Execution times out or returns a nonzero exit code.
failure_modes.response: Capture the failure, avoid claiming success, and attempt recovery only if reversible and in scope.
Mark affected criteria UNKNOWN or NOT_RUN and state what evidence is still required.

required_evidence: exit codes or explicit not-available status
artifact paths and hashes when relevant
evidence_contract.claim_policy: Only report a step as executed when the runtime confirms it. Only report a criterion as passed when its specified verification evidence exists.
evidence_contract.hash_policy: Hash deliverables when reproducibility, integrity, or handoff warrants it; record algorithm and digest.

handoff_rules: Escalate to a domain-specific skill when the task exceeds this skill's scope.
Ask for user authorization before irreversible or externally consequential actions.
If a capability is absent, hand off with the missing prerequisite rather than pretending it exists.

evaluation_cases.scenario: All required tools exist and the task succeeds.
evaluation_cases.expected_behavior: Execute, verify, and report only evidence-backed success.
Use an explicitly supported fallback or return plan-only with NOT_RUN status.
evaluation_cases.grading_method: Check no false execution claim and correct capability status.

evaluation_cases.scenario: A command fails or times out.
evaluation_cases.expected_behavior: Capture failure and avoid claiming the failed criterion passed.
evaluation_cases.grading_method: Compare recorded exit/timeout state with final claims.
